$comment: Topic taxonomy for tagging questions. Structure loosely follows the functional areas used in local-government management education (leadership, ethics, intergovernmental relations, health and safety, finance, community futures, essential services). Adjust IDs before you have real content — renaming them later means a data migration. Subtopics are additive and safe to extend; the 0.2.0 set was widened for the second-wave sources in data-sources/SOURCES.md.

competencies.label: Ethics & Integrity
competencies.description: Conflicts of interest, gifts, transparency, whistleblowing, personal conduct of appointed officials.

competencies.label: Budgeting & Financial Management
competencies.description: Operating and capital budgets, revenue forecasting, debt, reserves, audits, fiscal distress.

competencies.label: Organizational Leadership
competencies.description: Managing staff, org design, change management, executive-council relations.

competencies.label: Human Resources & Labor
competencies.description: Hiring, collective bargaining, discipline, compensation, workforce planning.

competencies.label: Intergovernmental Relations
competencies.description: State preemption, county/city agreements, regional bodies, federal grants, mutual aid.

competencies.label: Public Health & Safety
competencies.description: Police, fire, EMS, emergency management, public health emergencies.

competencies.label: Essential Services & Infrastructure
competencies.description: Water, sewer, solid waste, streets, transit, asset management, deferred maintenance.

competencies.label: Community Futures & Development
competencies.description: Land use, zoning, housing, economic development, climate adaptation, demographic change.

competencies.label: Citizen Engagement & Communication
competencies.description: Public meetings, media, crisis communication, participatory processes.

competencies.label: Performance Management & Data
competencies.description: KPIs, benchmarking, program evaluation, open data, service-level measurement.

difficulty_levels.label: Applied
difficulty_levels.description: Apply a known rule or practice to a clear situation.

difficulty_levels.label: Judgment
difficulty_levels.description: Competing goods, incomplete information, no clean answer.
